correctness.rationale: Closed first-harmonic backward generator has entries (-a,α; βc,-b) and exact initial (1,0), determining the Laplace transform (z+b)/((z+a)(z+b)-αβc). Its discriminant exactly partitions the parameter space; for c<0, strict inequality sqrtΔ<|a-b| makes the positive/no-zero and unique-one-zero cases rigorous, and Δ<0 gives infinitely many simple zeros. For c≥0 the generator is Metzler and the no-transition term is strictly positive. Matrix exponentials and an independent 4-state jump chain agreed across 2,730 tests; calculations support but are not a substitute for the analytic proof. All boundary and normalization cases were checked.

value.rationale: The analytic trichotomy is a meaningful all-parameter boundary for signed persistence in a common run/turn model, including the counterintuitive positive-correlation sector despite a negative mean angle cosine, the single sign reversal, and infinitely oscillatory memory. The exact critical rate ratios \(3\pm2\sqrt2\) are nontrivial physical cutoffs determining curvature sign transitions of the equilibrium MSD, not arbitrary fixed numeric samples. Limitations to the exponential Markov class and pre-existing general VACF transform are explicit.
